d:
Dhirendra Shastri is facing fresh controversy over his remarks about Lord Ram and his father Dasharath.
Akhilesh Yadav shared a video of the statement and strongly criticised the spiritual leader.
Congress leader Pappu Yadav and several other political leaders have also opposed his remarks.
Several saints from Mathura and Braj have reportedly called for a boycott of his kathaon.
Dhirendra Shastri has responded to his earlier Lord Krishna remarks, but his response to the Lord Ram controversy is awaited.
